## Review Schedule

- **Monthly**: Verify all links work
- **Quarterly**: Update examples and code samples
- **On feature add**: Update relevant guides + PROJECT_INDEX.md
- **On structure change**: Update all navigation files

## Maintenance Checklist

When making documentation changes:

- [ ] Updated the appropriate main document
- [ ] Updated PROJECT_INDEX.md if files/components added
- [ ] Updated START_HERE.md if major documentation added
- [ ] Verified all cross-references work
- [ ] Followed formatting standards from DOCUMENTATION.md
- [ ] Logged changes in this CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] Tested all code examples
- [ ] Verified all links resolve
